recent_updates.title: Release-Based Cleanup Regs (RBCRs) — Effective
recent_updates.description: RBCRs took effect March 1, 2026, establishing Connecticut’s release-based reporting and cleanup system while preserving applicable transition pathways for existing cleanup programs.

recent_updates.title: MS4 General Permit — Draft Reissuance
recent_updates.description: CT DEEP issued a Notice of Tentative Determination to reissue the MS4 General Permit; public comment period opened March 25, 2025.

recent_updates.title: REACT Portal Launch
recent_updates.description: CT DEEP's new Release, Environmental Assessment, and Cleanup Tracker (REACT) portal is live for document uploads and tracking as of early 2026.

recent_updates.title: Release Remediation Closure Report Guide — Published
recent_updates.description: CT DEEP replaced its Verification Report Guidance Document with updated guidance for documenting release remediation closure and compliance across cleanup programs.

documents.title: Release-Based Cleanup Program

documents.verification_note: The RBCRs establish the current general release-based framework. Existing Property Transfer and other program obligations may continue or transition under applicable provisions; ERI does not describe those obligations as categorically replaced.

documents.title: Environmental Cleanup — REACT Portal & Overview

documents.title: Technical Impracticability (TI) Variance
documents.description: CT DEEP guidance for the current RBCR technical-impracticability variance used to manage qualifying chronic groundwater impacts where applicable criteria cannot be achieved with readily available technology within a reasonable timeframe.
documents.publisher: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

documents.title: Engineered Controls (ECs) — Overview
documents.description: CT DEEP guidance and application materials for engineered controls used under the current RBCR framework to prevent exposure to polluted soil or minimize pollutant migration, including applicable variance, stewardship, financial-assurance, and completion requirements.
documents.publisher: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

documents.title: Licensed Environmental Professional (LEP) Program

documents.title: LEP Verifications — Forms & Instructions

documents.title: Release Remediation Closure Report Guide
documents.description: CT DEEP guidance for documenting closure after remediation or when characterization demonstrates that remediation is unnecessary. documents.title: Voluntary Remediation Programs — Overview

documents.verification_note: The page maintains current and legacy program information together; ERI does not infer which voluntary or transition pathway applies to a property.

documents.title: Remediation Forms — Central Repository
